integrity: Proof is self-contained, with exact finite enumeration supplementary rather than substituted for infinite-order reasoning. No independent audit was undertaken.
scientific_limitations: Uniform insertion-order binary search trees, total internal zero-child leaves and ordinary edge-count depth only. No statement for biased insertions, external leaves, weighted depth, or joint weak convergence. Literature priority may require additional independent historical verification.
title: Opposite signs of depth–leaf covariance at extremal and interior keys of random binary search trees
